headline: STMicroelectronics presentation covers metric-driven analog/mixed-signal IP verification
fact: Cadence’s account of DAC 2012 identifies STMicroelectronics’ Pierluigi Daglio and Marco Carlini as authors of “Metric Driven Verification Approach for Analog/Mixed Signal IPs.” The account dates the presentation at the EDA360 Theater in San Francisco to June 5 at 4 p.m. The account was published on August 27, 2012.

sources.title: Mixed Signal Design IP Embraces Metric-Driven Verification Using RNM
sources.summary: Cadence’s August 27, 2012 article names the STMicroelectronics authors and gives June 5 at 4 p.m. for their DAC presentation. Its general RNM discussion does not establish ST implementation details. Linked historical slides and audio now redirect to the Cadence homepage and were not reviewed.
